text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait's ambassador to the United States says Washington reaffirmed its commitment to the Gulf Arab state's security.
- Kuwait Airways Corp made 1,118 flights in June.
- National Industries Co reiterates plans to increase its industrial assets to $1 billion.
- Four Iranians arrested for illegal entry.
- Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah received on Tuesday Malawi's Foreign Minister George Ntfau.
- Bosnia's Prime Minister Haris Silajdzic hails Kuwait's support to his country.
- Petrochemical complex at Shuaiba to start production in 1997, Senior official at Petrochemical Industries Company (PIC) says.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange's index rose 4.1 points on Tuesday to 2,456.7.
